content.title: I’ve never been to Coachella so can someone explain the difference between Weekend 1 and Weekend 2. Is there a better weekend and do the same surprise guests pop up?? 🙈

Weekend 2 is for the Music Lovers.That’s how it’s always been described to me.Weekend 1, you see way more influencers, celebs, etc. & used to be more special guests.Now, it looks like Weekend 2 is getting bigger guests every year the past couple years.Like296CommentRepostShare1loveysweetykins04/19/25MoreI’ve only been coming to Coachella since 2018, but over time I feel that weekend 2 is better for me. Weekend 1 has more influencers and celebrities. People seem to be there more to just say they were there and get photos. Weekend 2 is more for the people who are there for the art and music. As for surprise guests, I’ve either seen artists not bring out the special guest that they brought out weekend 1 or they bring out someone else. Weekend 2 has the kinks sorted out, but is more dusty.Like3Comment2RepostSharetherealcmtaylor04/18/25Liked by original authorMoreWeekend 1 is packed with regular folks but also a majority of influencers and other artists. Weekend 2 is more low key with less people but still raging amongst music enthusiasts and people that want to have fun.Like69CommentRepostSharecatatonique04/19/25MoreSame main lineup, except do lab who has different ones.
